digest.component_or_area: CI checkout and tickets store initialization
propositions: Fresh full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB / 59s wall time; partial clone with --filter=blob:none reduces this to 68.7 MiB / 14.3s (15x reduction)
CI actions/checkout for tickets takes 237s; rebar fetch operations are post-clone and cannot apply git filters, making the filter input the only size lever
When tickets fetch times out, rebar silently bootstraps an orphan empty store via worktree add --orphan, diverging from origin/tickets and causing all reads to return empty results
Blob:none partial clone preserves the complete commit graph needed for merge-base and commit-ancestry scoping; only blobs are lazy-fetched from the working tree
Current gerrit-verify.yaml verify-identity job is a full-history fetch taking 6.73m (92% of 7.3m total job), with the actual rebar verify-identity taking only 0.08m
Implementation requires merge.ours.driver configuration before blob:none filter is applied, and fail-closed error handling instead of orphan bootstrap to fix P1 bug 01e8-302b
